blind.description: A small rectangular dark-stained wooden tray or low crate resting on small corner feet, containing neatly packed, short cylindrical cream-coloured candles with small black wicks. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no floating, broken, or melted geometry, and no active flames.
blind.from_above: A rectangular brown frame enclosing sixteen circular cream-coloured candle tops arranged in rough rows, each with a dark wick mark in the centre.
blind.height_vs_figure: Very low to the ground, around 3 to 4 inches tall (roughly 1/20 of the figure's height), with a tray width of about 1.2 feet.
